_comment: Local game fixtures. Copy this file to registry.json (git-ignored) and
edit it; never commit registry.json or anything under fixtures/<id>/game/.
Every path is resolved against the repo root when relative, so a
registry written on one machine can be re-pointed on another by editing
`python tools/fixtures.py doctor --id <id>` probes the real values and
prints the registry's answer beside them, so drift is visible.
redistributable=false means NO output from this fixture may ever be
committed (that is the default for licensed games).

limbus.notes: The store global-metadata.dat stays encrypted; only BepInEx/decrypted-metadata.dat is readable, so --metadata is mandatory (directory discovery only looks for global-metadata.dat).
